name: Greiner CELLSTAR 655090 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Greiner Bio-One CELLSTAR 96 well microplate, PS, F-bottom chimney well, uClear film bottom, TC-treated, sterile, lid with condensation rings. Despite being catalogued under 'clear' cell culture microplates, this is a BLACK-walled plate with a clear uClear bottom - see product data sheet PDS 65509x rev 06 section 1.5, 'black plate, clear bottom, clear lid'. Dimensions from Greiner customer drawing rev 3 (2021-09-27), '96 Well Microplate, PS, uClear Chimney Well', valid for 655090/655094/655095/655096/655097/655098. Units in meters. Footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm +/- 0.2, plate height 14.4 mm +/- 0.1, flange/skirt height 2.5 mm. Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm. A1 well center is 14.38 mm from the left edge (A1 column offset) and 11.24 mm from the top edge (A1 row offset). Well top diameter 6.96 mm, bottom diameter 6.58 mm, depth 10.9 mm, flat chimney-well bottom. uClear film bottom is 190 um +/- 10 percent polystyrene. Total well volume 392 uL, working volume 25-340 uL, growth area 0.34 cm^2. Greiner states the footprint conforms to ANSI/SBS 1-2004. The Greiner Microplate Dimensions Guide (F073027) prints the top diameter as 6.69 mm, which conflicts with the 6.96 mm on the controlled per-catalogue drawing; the drawing value is used here. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
